verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own 'Filters & Rules' help article, and community users refer to migrating their filters and rules, so rule-based automation exists as a first-party feature. The pack gives only the article title, though, with no detail on triggers, conditions or actions. JMAP push (EventSource/WebPush) is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented trigger/event types, documented actions (move, label, forward, etc.), condition logic depth, any AI-native or programmatic rule management, and hands-on corroboration of rules running automatically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
